---
name: Feature request
about: A new alpha template, gate rule, or workflow improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What's the use case?

Describe the problem you're trying to solve. A specific alpha or a
class of alphas you want to express.

## Proposed solution

If you have a concrete idea (a new template expression, a new gate
metric, a new CLI flag), sketch it here.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why is the proposed
one better?

## Self-corr risk

If this is a new alpha template: what data family does it use
(PV, Fundamental, Analyst, Sentiment, ...)? What existing templates
would it correlate with?
